other_failure_modes.name: XGBoost Label Encoding Error
other_failure_modes.description: XGBClassifier strictly requires multiclass labels to be sequential integers starting from 0 (i.e., [0, num_classes - 1]). The agent's target encoding logic blindly casts to integers if possible. For the satimage dataset, which has non-sequential integer classes (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7), this will cause XGBoost to crash with a ValueError during fitting.

summary: The agent successfully implements pipelines to avoid data leakage and handles the multi-model ensembling logic fairly well using accuracy weighting. However, the solution suffers from a critical execution failure: the target encoding blindly preserves raw integers, which will cause XGBoost to crash on the non-0-indexed, non-sequential classes of the satimage dataset (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7). Additionally, the agent performs no feature engineering and evaluates the models on a single validation split without cross-validation.
